==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:margarine|margarine]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
*8–10 [[Cookbook:Cracker|crackers]]
*[[Cookbook:Sour Cream|Sour cream]]

==Procedure==
#Melt half the butter in a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
#Turn the burner to medium heat. Add the diced onions to the pan.
#Slowly caramelize the onions, adding in the rest of the butter as needed to keep from burning.
#Once caramelized, add the brown sugar and the honey. Combine thoroughly until all the onions are glazed.
#Place onions attractively onto the crackers, and finish with a small dollop of sour cream.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Keep an eye on the onions—they burn easily.
*Measurements are not exact; play around to see what you like.
